prompt.text:
Make a 30-second vertical motion-graphics explainer (1080×1920, 30 fps) on how GPS finds your phone.

Use `script.md` for the exact on-screen text and `sources/` for the facts. No voiceover. For sound, use only the music bed and sound effects in `benchmarks/shared/audio/`. Go for a clean, modern, flat style with animated diagrams.

revision_prompt.text: Revise only the trilateration scene (script scene 5). Make its satellite and sphere diagram 20% larger, change that scene's accent color to #00C2A8, and change its first line to the exact text "One signal: you're somewhere on this sphere." Leave every other scene, the total length and the audio unchanged.

assumptions: Scene cuts sit on bar lines or on beat 3 (backbeat): 0/2.4/7.2/10.8/15.6/22.8/26.4 s. All-downbeat cuts would have left the accuracy scene only 2.4 s. The hook is one bar (2.4 s); its copy min_seconds is set to 2.2 and the floor for all other lines is 1.5 s.
The music fade is done by a derived file (trim 0-30 s, 0.3 s fade-in, 2.4 s fade-out), because the pipeline has no fade control and the audio README says to trim and fade to fit.
The 31 / 20,200 / 4.9 numbers are animated counters (script visual intent), so intermediate values show while counting; 16 ft is static copy.

Revision: 'that scene's accent color' = the trilateration scene's accent (first sphere, candidate dots, pin, burst), now #00C2A8. Signal lines (house teal) and the clock (yellow) are unchanged. '20% larger' = the whole satellite+sphere diagram scaled 1.2x about its origin; the text is unchanged.

agent_checks.item: Every line in script.md appears exactly once, spelled exactly, fully readable (not clipped, not covered, on screen >= 1.5 s)
agent_checks.evidence: Headless inspector (engine/inspect.mjs, every 3rd frame) on draft v1 and revised v2, joined visible text (opacity >= 0.5): each of the 15 lines is found in exactly 1 continuous run. Shortest runs: 'about 20,200 km up' frames 162-213 (1.8 s), 'How does your phone know where you are?' 0-69 (2.4 s), 'its exact position' 252-321 (2.4 s), 'A fourth satellite corrects your phone's clock' 612-681 (2.4 s), 'within 4.9 m (16 ft)' 717-789 (2.5 s), 'Source: GPS.gov' 825-897 (2.5 s); all others 3.0-4.8 s. mstudio qa copy check 15/15, 0 too brief, text_size >= 30 px and safe_area pass on both versions. Checked visually in the MP4 contact sheets and in full frames at 2.3/7.1/10.6/15.5/19.3/22.7/26.3/29.95 s. In v2 the scene 5 first line is the requested 'One signal: you're somewhere on this sphere.' (frames 468-573).

agent_checks.item: No on-screen text or numbers that are not in script.md
agent_checks.evidence: Inspector: every text block across 300 samples per version is a substring of a script line; the diagrams carry no labels, digits or glyphs. Caveat: the three animated counters show intermediate values while counting up (e.g. '13 GPS satellites orbit Earth' at about 3.0 s, 'about 12,xxx km up' during 4.8-5.4 s, 'within 3.0 m (16 ft)' during 23.3-24.0 s). This follows the script's visual intent (animated counters), and every counter lands exactly on the scripted value (mstudio qa numbers pass: counters end on bound display strings).

agent_checks.item: Scene 5 visibly shows the step from one sphere to an intersection of several
agent_checks.evidence: Draft and revised: at 16.4 s (frame 492) one satellite with one sphere and three candidate positions sliding along it; at 17.0 s (frame 510) a second sphere; from 18.0 s (frame 540) a third sphere grows; at 19.2 s (frame 576, bar 8 downbeat) the three spheres meet at one point, the pin slams in with a burst and three radius lines draw from the satellites to it; at 20.4 s (frame 612) a fourth satellite plus clock. Seen in the styleframes (frame-04-at-17s, frame-05-at-19.4s) and the master contact sheet.

agent_checks.item: Only the shared music and SFX files are used; the music fades in and out, with no clipping (true peak <= -1 dBTP)
agent_checks.evidence: Music: audio/music-30s-faded.wav, derived only from benchmarks/shared/audio/music-bed-100bpm-48s.wav (trim 0-30 s, 0.3 s fade-in, 2.4 s fade-out from 27.6 s). SFX cue sheet (renders/sfx-cues.json) uses only audio/sfx/sfx-{pop,tick,whoosh-short,riser,impact}.wav, copied byte-identical from benchmarks/shared/audio; auto_sfx is off, so no built-in library. Measured on the master: mean level -32.9 dB at 0.0 s, -17.1 dB at 1.0 s (fade-in), -18.4 dB at 28.8 s, -34.4 dB at 29.5 s, -47.4 dB at 29.85 s (fade-out). ffmpeg ebur128 on both versions: I = -14.0 LUFS, true peak -1.5 dBTP.

agent_checks.item: No blank, black or frozen frames outside intended holds
agent_checks.evidence: blackdetect (d=0.1, pix_th=0.05): no black segments in either version. freezedetect (ffmpeg defaults n=-60 dB, d=1 s) flags 2 near-static stretches in both: 24.13-25.23 s (after the 4.9 m counter lands; mostly the declared hold acc.hold 24.6-25.8 s) and 12.07-13.17 s in the distance scene, between the signal's arrival (12.0 s) and the measure bracket (13.2 s). The second is NOT a declared hold: only the sub-pixel grid drift moves. mstudio qa black_freeze passed (0 frozen stretches) because its threshold is less strict, so I record this as a failure.

agent_checks.item: Revision: only scene 5 changed. Other scenes are frame-identical (or hash-identical modules) to the draft.
agent_checks.evidence: Module hashes: compositions/{hook,constellation,broadcast,distance,accuracy,endcard}.html and index.html, timing.js, brand.css, data.js and beatmap.json are SHA-256 identical between versions/v1 and v2; only compositions/trilateration.html changed. Audio stream MD5 is identical (0a89088a...). mstudio revise verify: 212 changed frames, all inside the trilateration window [468, 684). Caveat: the decoded frames outside scene 5 are not bit-identical. Framemd5 differs on 441 of 684 outside frames, but the minimum PSNR there is 51.97 dB (max MSE 0.41 of 255), which looks like rasterization/encoder noise, not a visible change. Frames 0-74 and 215-359 are bit-identical.

notes: Claude Code desktop app on Windows 11. D: had 0.5 GB free and HyperFrames refuses to render with low disk, so projects/gps-explainer/renders is a directory junction to the session scratchpad on C: (nothing on D: deleted). The first render's riser SFX was dropped by the density rule; I moved it to tri.sat3 and re-rendered before draft-delivered. bench.py start warned that an old motion-engine 0.63.1 is on PATH (not used; mstudio from the checkout venv). Weakest part: the distance scene has a 1.1 s near-static stretch (12.07-13.17 s) and small, label-free diagrams; the spheres are drawn as 2D circles.

owner_review.comment: Owner: 4 overall, applied to all five dimensions. No explicit publish answer was given, so it is recorded as no.
